answer.reason: The verses tell of Ishmael's killing at Mizpah, his massacre of the pilgrims, and his carrying off of captives.

clauses.english: slew Gedaliah the governor at Mizpah, with those who were with him
clauses.quote: smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword

clauses.english: slew eighty pilgrims and cast them into a pit
clauses.quote: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit

clauses.english: carried the people of Mizpah away captive toward the Ammonites
clauses.quote: carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites
